title: T243 PNC - There Is a Tzaddik So Great That the World Cannot Bear His Holiness
hebrewTitle: יש צדיק שגדול כל כך שהעולם לא יכול לשאת את קדושתו
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: There exists a tzaddik so spiritually elevated that the world itself cannot bear his holiness. Therefore he must hide himself very much, and people do not see him for who he truly is. Some of the greatest tzaddikim in history were never recognized in their own time — their holiness was simply too intense for the surrounding world to perceive. This teaches humility about our judgments of others: we may be in the presence of an extraordinary soul and not realize it. It also teaches us about Rebbe Nachman himself, whose true greatness was hidden from most of his contemporaries.

intermediate.en: T243: There is a tzaddik so great that the world cannot bear his kedushah (holiness). Therefore he hides himself profoundly and is not perceived. Some of history's greatest tzaddikim were unrecognized in their generations — their light too intense for surrounding perception. LM 243.
intermediate.he: יש צדיק כל כך גדול שהעולם לא יכול לשאת את קדושתו — לכן מסתיר עצמו, ואין רואים אותו. גדולי הדורות לעיתים נסתרים מבני זמנם.

scholarly.he: LM א׳ רמ״ג — "יש צדיק גדול מאד שהעולם לא יכול לסבול קדושתו, לכן מסתיר עצמו הרבה ואין רואין".
